name: Run a longitudinal practice study
short_description: Design and run a six-month personal practice study with repeated measures, controlled changes, and documented revisions.
self_assessment: I can run a six-month practice study without help and document six evidence-based revisions.
description: Design and run a six-month personal practice study with repeated measures, controlled changes, and documented revisions. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Compare two practice schedules over six months
